definitions.explanation: The up-down direction, or the longer dimension of a rectangular object. Contrasts with {横|よこ} (horizontal, width).

examples.japanese: {縦|たて}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}んで→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{縦|たて}30⟦センチ→センチ：01372_senchi⟧、⟦{横|よこ}→横：02984_yoko⟧20⟦センチ→センチ：01372_senchi⟧だ。
examples.english: This box is 30 cm long and 20 cm wide.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{縦|たて}{書|が}き→縦書き：13871_tategaki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{横|よこ}{書|が}き→横書き：13188_yokogaki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{書|か}ける→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: Japanese can be written both vertically and horizontally.

notes:
USAGE:
- {縦|たて}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: vertically, lengthwise
- {縦|たて}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: vertical ~

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{縦|たて}{書|が}き→縦書き：13871_tategaki⟧: vertical writing
- ⟦{縦|たて}{長|なが}→縦長：18226_tatenaga⟧: portrait orientation, taller than wide
- {縦|たて}⟦{横|よこ}→横：02984_yoko⟧: length and width; all directions
- ⟦{縦|たて}{線|せん}→縦線：25122_tatesen⟧: vertical line
- {縦|たて}⟦{列|れつ}→列：02171_retsu⟧: column (vertical row)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{縦|たて} (vertical, length) ↔ ⟦{横|よこ}→横：02984_yoko⟧ (horizontal, width). These are frequently used as a pair.
